title: Generic Ramanujan for exceptional groups over function fields
exact_target: Over every global function field F, is every local component of every complex globally generic cuspidal representation of a split connected adjoint absolutely simple group of type G2,F4,E6,E7 or E8 tempered, including arbitrarily ramified places and every characteristic?
